tool_args.rationale: Hydraulic saturation with an additive square-root sink reproduces all seven paid observations within 5e-8, including both wide-gradient measurements. The fitted rho is approximately 0.902, outside the recalled source range. Submit for fresh confirmation at H=0.6.

considered_alternatives.option: Hydraulic saturation with source-range rho and no separate sink
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The wide-gradient observations require stronger attenuation than the recalled rho range allows, and the branch-free fit leaves systematic residuals.
Haldane alone has no gradient dependence; Cobb–Douglas does not capture the saturation in u_now. Neither explains the paid rows at their reported precision.
The wide-gradient probe resolved the ambiguity at H=0.6. The three-parameter law already matches every paid row to rounding precision.
